seo.title: Find an Ankur Salt Distributor Near You | Nationwide Network
seo.description: Find a trusted Ankur Salt distributor near you: stockists and dealers across India, from the salt pans of Kutch to kitchens nationwide. Interested in becoming a distributor? Apply here.

hero.heading: Find Ankur near you.
hero.intro: From the salt pans of Kutch to kitchens across the country, Ankur reaches homes through a trusted network of distributors nationwide.

becomeDistributor.heading: Become a distributor.
becomeDistributor.intro: Interested in stocking Ankur products in your region? Tell us about your business, and our team will get in touch.
benefits: A brand trusted in Indian kitchens since 1994

placeholders.message: Tell us about your business and current distribution reach.

becomeDistributor.successMessage: Thanks for your interest. Our team will reach out within 2 to 3 business days.

connectWithDistributor.heading: Connect with distributors
connectWithDistributor.intro: Have a question for one of our distributors — stock availability, order status, or anything else? Send us a message and we'll help connect you.
benefits: A real person reads every message that comes through here
Connected with the right distributor for your city
Quick response, usually within 1 to 2 business days
